ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: X on Track uses your camera to photograph foods and meals and to scan barcodes and nutrition labels.
ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: X on Track reads Health data (such as activity, workouts, and body measurements) to display it in the app and sync it to your self-hosted X on Track server.
ios.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: X on Track writes nutrition, hydration, and completed workouts you log in the app to Apple Health when you enable each export.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: X on Track connects to self-hosted servers on your local network.
